title: python/src/lichen/ccp.py: Division by zero when num_slots is 0
description:
The slot_hash function performs `h % num_slots` without validating that num_slots is non-zero. If a caller passes num_slots=0, this raises ZeroDivisionError and crashes.

Fix suggestion: Add validation at function start: `if num_slots <= 0: raise ValueError('num_slots must be positive')`
